items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: William McLamore was playing guitar with me when he first left the school.

ctx.x: Bobby Smith. He, I don't know if you remember a band called Sunset Royal Entertainers around New York. When they broke up, Bobby Smith, I brought him in as my first alto player. He also was the writer of "Tippin In", one of my, one of my big tunes.

LeRoy Kirkland, the guitar. He did a lot of writing for me. He was with the old Sunset Royal band too. So, William McLamore was playing guitar with me when he first left the school. But, he decided to put it down and he went into a business.
And Joe Murphy, the drums. He was, he joined me after Ace Harris was with me. Ace Harris, pianist? Ace Harris followed Avery Parrish. Avery went out on his own.
